name: dsh-session-pins
description: Durable session pinning for the DSH web UI: a pin/unpin item inside the session row menu (next to rename) plus a pinned-sessions section at the top of the sidebar browsing region. Pins live in a host-side JSON store (~/.dsh/storages/session-pins.json), so unlike the stock browser-local session order they survive restarts and the per-launch random port.
